content.text:
I could not confirm the billing history for t007. The ticket record contains only the customer's message. It has no charge amount, charge date, plan details, or cancellation record.

- **$120 annual charge:** The customer claims it, but no charge record for t007 appears in the ticket system, so I can't verify the amount or date.
- **March cancellation:** The customer says they cancelled in March and have a confirmation email. Nothing in the ticket data shows a cancellation or its date, so I can't confirm or refute it.
- **Related tickets:** A keyword search returned other billing tickets (t001, t019, t036, t041). None of them mention t007's account, so I did not use them here. They should be checked separately before anyone links them to this customer.

To complete this check, someone with access to the billing or subscription system needs to pull t007's charge history for the $120 annual charge and the cancellation log for March. The customer has said they will dispute the charge with their bank if it is not reversed today. That deadline is not something I can act on or promise. It should go to billing staff now.
